name: DGF 2027: 33rd Annual Meeting of the German Finance Association
organizer: German Finance Association (DGF); hosted by the Free University of Bozen-Bolzano
venue: Free University of Bozen-Bolzano, Universitätsplatz 1 - piazza Università 1
conf_dates_note: Doctoral workshop and Women-in-Finance event on 30 September; main conference 1-2 October 2027.
deadline_note: Submission window 1 March - 15 April 2027. The host page says the formal call is planned to be published in January 2027; its timeline section shows inconsistent years (e.g. "April 15, 2026").
submission_requirements: Full papers in English, PDF, anonymized for double-blind review; abstract of no more than 120 words; online submission system only. Doctoral workshop applications by 3 Jul 2027; Women-in-Finance abstracts by 15 Aug 2027.
submission_fee: Free for DGF members; EUR 40 for non-members
registration_fee: EUR 260 early (to 31 Jul) / EUR 280 regular (to 30 Aug) / EUR 320 late (to 16 Sep); PhD students EUR 190 / 210 / 240
